segments.ja223:1.1: Name namantassa bhaje bhajantaṃ, kiccānukubbassa kareyya kiccaṃ;
segments.ja223:1.3: Nānatthakāmassa kareyya atthaṃ, asambhajantampi na sambhajeyya.
segments.ja223:2.1: Caje cajantaṃ vanathaṃ na kayirā, apetacittena na sambhajeyya;
segments.ja223:2.3: Dijo dumaṃ khīṇaphalanti ñatvā, aññaṃ samekkheyya mahā hi lokoti.

lines: Tattha name namantassa bhaje bhajantanti yo attano namati, tasseva paṭinameyya.
Kiccānukubbassa kareyya kiccanti attano uppannakiccaṃ anukubbantasseva tassapi uppannakiccaṃ paṭikareyya.
Caje cajantaṃ vanathaṃ na kayirāti attānaṃ jahantaṃ jaheyyeva, tasmiṃ taṇhāsaṅkhātaṃ vanathaṃ na kareyya.
Dijo dumanti yathā sakuṇo pubbe phalitampi rukkhaṃ phale khīṇe “khīṇaphalo ayan”ti ñatvā taṃ chaḍḍetvā aññaṃ samekkhati pariyesati, evaṃ aññaṃ samekkheyya.
Mahā hi esa loko, atha tumhe sasnehaṃ ekaṃ purisaṃ labhissathāti.
